title: Animation Markers do not signal 'animation_changed' in AnimationLibrary
body:
### Tested versions

Tested in 4.4beta4

### System information

Godot v4.4.beta4 - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13700K (24 threads)

### Issue description

Related to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/91765

Making any change to an animation within the Animation tab will send an 'animation_changed' signal from the AnimationLibrary. However, this is not the case for Animation Markers. The following changes can be performed to an Animation Marker (none of which emit a signal):
- Inserting a marker
- Deleting a marker
- Renaming a marker
- Moving a marker
- Changing the colour of a marker

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the marker_changed scene in the MRP and click on the Animation node.
2. Make changes to the Animation (insert keys, create tracks etc) and observe Sprite2D changing colour.
3. Create or change an existing marker and observe no change to Sprite2D as the 'animation_changed' signal did not get emitted.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[animationmarkernochangedsignal_2025-02-19_12-58-09.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18868404/animationmarkernochangedsignal_2025-02-19_12-58-09.zip)
